Footer.tagline: Mobile training center specialized in fiber optics, photovoltaics and EV charging stations (IRVE) in Tunisia.

Home.heroDescription: NovaLead trains technicians and companies in fiber optics, photovoltaics and telecommunications in Tunisia — certified, field-focused programs.

About.heroSubtitle: A mobile training center specialized in fiber optics, photovoltaics and EV charging stations (IRVE) — backed by 15+ years of experience in France.
About.conceptP1: Instead of waiting for trainees in a traditional classroom, we travel directly to Tunisia's different regions to make training accessible to as many people as possible.
About.conceptP2: With over 15 years of experience in France in fiber optics, photovoltaics and EV charging (IRVE), we pass on professional know-how based on European methods and standards.
About.conceptP3: Our goal is simple: to train qualified technicians through practical, concrete programs adapted to market needs.

fibre.label: Fiber Optics
fibre.description: Installation, connection, splicing and measurement of FTTH fiber networks, from design to the subscriber connection.

photovoltaique.label: Photovoltaics
photovoltaique.description: Design, installation and maintenance of residential and professional solar photovoltaic systems.

irve.label: EV Charging (IRVE)
irve.description: Installation, connection and commissioning of charging stations for electric vehicles (IRVE).

1.description: Understand FTTH network architecture and the basics of fiber deployment, from reading plans to pulling cables.
objectives: Fundamentals: fiber principles, fiber types, FTTH architecture (NRO, PM, PBO, PTO), standards
Reading plans: schematics, box layouts, field surveying, color codes
Pulling & deployment: aerial, underground, façade and riser

2.description: Master optical connection: preparation, cleaving, fusion splicing, connectorization and subscriber connection (D3).
objectives: Connection: preparation, cleaving, fusion splicing, connectorization, slack management
Subscriber connection (D3): PTO installation, box commissioning, customer relations
Safety: PPE, work at height, AIPR, certifications

3.description: Check network quality: photometry, OTDR reflectometry, optical budget and acceptance deliverables.
objectives: Measurement & testing: photometry, reflectometry (OTDR), optical budget
Acceptance & deliverables: acceptance reports, work logs, photo reports

4.description: Study and size a solar installation, from solar energy basics to reading electrical plans.
objectives: Study and sizing of an installation

5.description: Install and connect a photovoltaic system: panels, inverters, storage systems and commissioning.

6.description: Maintain and troubleshoot solar installations in compliance with standards and safety.

7.description: Discover IRVE regulations, electric-vehicle technology and the sizing of charging stations.

8.description: Install and connect charging stations: electrical protections, configuration and commissioning.

9.description: Diagnose and maintain charging stations safely, with hands-on case studies.
